Xiao Xiao is the finest among the Dragon Kin. As a direct descendant of [Zhu Long] Li Dao, he was sent by Li Dao to be raised by Zhao Ming in his youth, to escape the chaotic strife of the southern frontier and the ceaseless assassination attempts of the Indi. As the prized disciple of the Lord of Shang Yang, he tempered his meridians from childhood with the "Art of Elixir Cauldron Body-Forging," so that not only does the flame of the Zhu Long flow within him, but he also wields tremendous magic drawn from the same source as the alchemical arts.\\nSince taking command as an adult, his peerless martial skill has earned him the title "peerless in ferocity, a bane to the wicked and depraved" among the generals of Wei Xi. Among his fellow Dragon Kin, it seems only Xuan Lie's brute strength has ever gotten the better of him in their sparring matches. Sent by the will of Li Dao and Zhao Ming to serve under Commander Miao Ying at the Long Wall, he became deeply impressed by the Lord of Raging Gale's brilliant foresight, and under her command he has repelled wave after wave of Chaos incursions beyond the Long Wall.
